name: 深空靛蓝棱镜光感精华液款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：产品全身立于纯白底，干净合规抢点击。
承接首屏：深靛蓝网格隧道与棱镜光环把科技感一次讲完。
shots.textZone: upper third headline slot with one short ribbon callout beneath it

shots.intent: 用四枚圆形材质窗把用户自己的肌肤困扰一次摊开，勾住下滑。
shots.textZone: one short label under each circle window, headline bar across the top

shots.intent: 超大编号配三条短句，把作用逻辑拆成可读完的三步。
shots.textZone: three numbered rows stacked on the left half, each a title plus one short secondary line

shots.intent: 用取液口与一滴精华的微距证明质地与工艺，替代任何参数口播。
把产品放进真实晚间护肤台面，让买家自我代入使用时刻。
同机位同光的左右材质对照，把困扰与改善后的观感并排放。
shots.textZone: one short label under each of the two panels

shots.intent: 白卡上平铺三支递进规格，让买家一步选完不再纠结。
shots.textZone: one small label tag under each unit

shots.intent: 用六行空白参数卡把规格信息交回真实资料，降风险而不写死数据。
shots.textZone: six row label and value slots on the right-hand card

shots.intent: 深靛蓝留白场收尾，一句主张加一个按钮完成详情页最后一步。
shots.textZone: one short closing line above one small pill button on the lower band

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech deep-indigo serum visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep space indigo #171C63, cloud white #FFFFFF, ice-blue prism highlight #BFE3F5 and titanium silver #C9CFD6; cool high-key studio lighting around 6500K with a soft front-left key, fill card, one narrow specular strip on the metal collar, hard thin rim glints and soft single-direction contact shadows; background system of full-bleed deep space indigo #171C63 screens carrying a one-point perspective wireframe laser grid, bevelled clear glass refraction slabs, one thin iridescent light ring and small four-point star glints, alternating with cloud white #FFFFFF infographic pages holding blank cards and circle windows; modern geometric sans-serif with titanium-silver metallic oversized numerals, ghost numerals and dotted hairline rules; thin single-weight outline icon style in #BFE3F5 inside blank circle chips, no filled illustration; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

no real numbers, certificates or efficacy figures printed in frame
